comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record safely discharges a capacitor before removing a power-supply board.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines tab probing, wire bending, and coordinated withdrawal; record maintains two-point electrical contact for a timed interval, then extracts and bins a board.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective terminal extraction; record requires verified discharge before board motion or unsafe contact, followed by released placement.
comparison.reason: The defining record ability is ordered electrical-safety contact, not mechanical latch release.
